  • I enjoy working at Viz.ai, because of the dedication to improving patient outcomes and saving lives. We have an amazing team with a strong focus on collaboration and innovation. We use cutting edge technologies to develop innovative solutions for healthcare.

    Oded Cohen

    Vice President of Engineering

Viz.ai is blazing a new trail with AI-powered Intelligent Care Coordination

Viz.ai uses artificial intelligence to accelerate care coordination, reducing the time between diagnosis and treatment for patients with life-threatening conditions such as stroke, pulmonary embolism and aortic dissection. We are expanding our product portfolio and geographic reach by focusing on new disease states and by expanding globally.

The core values that define the work we do

Patients First

We’re here for our patients, they impact every decision.

Time is Brain

We move quickly, because every patient deserves access to life saving treatment.

Quality Squared

We play by the rules and deliver excellence.

Kindness Wins

We strive to build a culture of kindness.

I am Accountable

I do what I say I will do, I follow through and follow up.

We’ve got you covered

Our benefits support every employee’s journey at Viz. From paid healthcare premiums and a 401K plan to generous vacation time and monthly Wellness Days, we offer each and every employee the opportunity to tend to fiscal, physical and mental health.

Career Growth

Work that Matters
